**Summary**
 The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting AI\-enabled solutions that enhance operational performance across manufacturing and business processes, while operating within the Information Technology organization. This role partners closely with Operations, Engineering, Finance, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and IT teams to identify high\-value use cases and translate operational challenges into scalable, secure, and compliant AI\-driven solutions.
   

  

 The position focuses on leveraging data, automation, and artificial intelligence to improve safety, quality, throughput, productivity, and process efficiency. The AI Engineer ensures solutions are aligned with IT architecture, security, and governance standards while remaining practical and usable within operational environments. This role also supports the deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI applications and provides technical expertise during adoption, troubleshooting, and process optimization efforts.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
**Functional**
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Finance, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and IT to identify and prioritize AI and data\-driven opportunities that improve safety, quality, and productivity
* Translate operational problems into defined AI use cases, including clear requirements, KPIs, and success criteria (e.g., downtime reduction, defect reduction, cycle time improvement)
* Design, develop, and deploy AI\-enabled applications, models, and automation solutions that integrate with enterprise systems and manufacturing processes

* Support continuous improvement efforts by analyzing operational data, identifying trends, and recommending AI\-driven enhancements
* Document AI systems, models, logic, and dependencies to support auditability, maintainability, and knowledge transfer
* Provide technical support and subject matter expertise to Operations, Engineering, Finance, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and IT teams, including troubleshooting and optimization of AI\-enabled processes
